name: Utah Quiet Championship 2026
information: # **This competition only has blindfolded events and FMC. We do not recommend this competition for first time competitors.** Due to the small size of the room, only 1 spectator per competitior will be allowed, however we highly reccomend you do not bring a spectator if possible. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
